# The pen's gate: a red panel 1.8 m long hinged at its RIGHT end (origin at the hinge), lying
# along -X when shut. Two rails, a diagonal brace, end posts. Generated by make_env.py. Up Z.
new
material new Gate --base-color 0.816 0.275 0.282 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name G1 --size 1 --location -0.900 0.000 0.280
scale 1.800 0.080 0.100
apply --scale
material assign Gate
add mesh cube --name G2 --size 1 --location -0.900 0.000 0.560
scale 1.800 0.080 0.100
apply --scale
material assign Gate
add mesh cube --name G3 --size 1 --location -0.080 0.000 0.360
scale 0.120 0.100 0.620
apply --scale
material assign Gate
add mesh cube --name G4 --size 1 --location -1.720 0.000 0.360
scale 0.120 0.100 0.620
apply --scale
material assign Gate
add mesh cube --name G5 --size 1 --location -0.9 0 0.42
scale 1.7 0.07 0.09
apply --scale
set rotation 0 -14 0
apply --rotation
material assign Gate
select all
active G1
join
rename G1 Gate
shade flat
export gate.glb
